title: 3 Habits That Quietly Change Your Life
voiceover: Here are three tiny habits that quietly change your life. One: write tomorrow's top task tonight. Two: walk ten minutes after every meal. Three: put your phone away one hour before sleep. Small steps, repeated daily, beat big plans you never start. Try one today.

title: Why You Feel Tired All Day
voiceover: Feeling tired all day? It is often not about sleep length, but sleep quality. Keep a fixed wake up time, get sunlight in the first hour, and cut caffeine after noon. Your energy follows your rhythm. Fix the rhythm, and the energy returns.
